summary: Explains the docs folder: Automation Hub shows markdown from docs/ for certified collections, docs.ansible.com shows RST from docs/docsite/rst for community collections defined via extra-docs.yml, and links.yml adds links to index and plugin pages.
questions: How do I add extra guides to my collection's page on docs.ansible.com?
Does Automation Hub show my collection's markdown docs?
How do I add custom links to my collection's documentation pages?

answer_card.title: The collection docs directory
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Certified collections:** Automation Hub shows Markdown files in `docs/` (no subdirectories); not published to docs.ansible.com.
- **Community collections in the Ansible package:** docs.ansible.com shows RST from `docs/docsite/rst/`, structured by `docs/docsite/extra-docs.yml`:
```yaml
sections:
- title: Scenario Guide
  toctree:
    - scenario_guide
```
- Add links to the index and plugin pages with `docs/docsite/links.yml`.
